rule.note: Frozen 2026-09-08 on SPY, the instrument actually traded. Supersedes the SPX freeze (fingerprint f209ac9a054c6df9), which named an index that cannot be bought: the record and the held position described different instruments, with different prices and different dividend treatment. Re-registered while the run still held zero bars and zero journal entries, so no forward evidence was discarded or reinterpreted — after any real data this correction would have cost the whole record. warmup_until is 2026-09-09, the day after the freeze: backfill history freely, but every bar fetched retrospectively fills the 200-day average and stays out of the record, so nothing already-known is passed off as forward evidence. Chosen as the best rule backtested on 1999-2018, NOT because it is expected to beat buy-and-hold: its information ratio against the benchmark was 0.046, which would need ~1900 years to distinguish from luck.
